Title:: Seeking to train & hire sound tech for 2027 open mics
Details::
The Williston Music Intensive is looking to hire someone to set up, tear down, & potentially run sound for the 2027 Spotlight open mic events. All training would be provided. 

Pay while training would start at $25/hour & increase to $200-$300 per event depending on the person's growth & ability to manage tasks independently.

The events are monthly & typically take place on Fridays at 6 pm. Setup takes place around 2 pm same day & requires 2 hours, while end-of-night teardown is anywhere from 30-90 minutes. Must have a vehicle & drivers license, as events sometimes require transporting equipment to new locations.
